name: com.faultydata/faultydata
description: Cited, replayable HTTP failure signatures — test any HTTP client against real outages.

tools.name: list_specimens
tools.description: List every failure specimen in the FaultyData registry as a compact summary (id, title, category, severity, path, real-world flag, test tags). Use get_specimen for the full story and signature.

tools.name: get_specimen
tools.description: Get a specimen's anatomy (the incident story), citation, and replay signature.

tools.name: replay_instructions
tools.description: How to replay a specimen against a client-under-test (URL, curl, params for seed/key).

tools.name: start_battery
tools.description: Mint a report-card battery token. The client then runs /run/{token}/{id} per specimen and reports outcomes.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Score a battery session and return the report card.
